reason: Expert reports that a firmware upgrade resets the ATPC setting to off, causing link fading in rain, and recommends checking ATPC after upgrades.

knowledge.summary: After firmware upgrades on these microwave links, the ATPC setting is reset to off, which can cause severe link fading during rain; check and re-enable ATPC after upgrading.
knowledge.author: Jari Jänne
knowledge.details: Firmware version 1.4 causes ATPC to be disabled.
